tasks.label: Create or verify the App Store Connect app record
tasks.location: My Apps > New App / App Information
tasks.action: Create the macOS app record or confirm the existing record uses this bundle id, SKU, category, and copyright.

tasks.label: Enter product page copy
tasks.location: Product Page > App Information / Version Information
tasks.action: Paste name, subtitle, promotional text, description, keywords, category, and copyright from the generated packet.

tasks.label: Upload Mac screenshots
tasks.action: Upload the generated Mac screenshots in order and re-check the App Store screenshot inventory.

tasks.label: Enter Support URL
tasks.action: Publish the support page, then enter the public HTTPS support URL.

tasks.label: Enter Privacy Policy URL
tasks.action: Publish the privacy page, then enter the public HTTPS privacy policy URL.

tasks.label: Complete App Privacy answers
tasks.evidence: No, this app does not collect data from the app.
tasks.action: Answer App Privacy as no data collected and confirm no tracking, analytics, ads, or developer off-device data collection were added.

tasks.label: Complete age rating questionnaire
tasks.evidence: 4+ candidate; App Store Connect generates the final rating from Apple's questionnaire.; 6 questionnaire note(s)
tasks.action: Answer Apple's questionnaire against the final shipped app behavior.

tasks.label: Set price
tasks.action: Set the final launch price in App Store Connect.

tasks.label: Set availability
tasks.evidence: All countries and regions candidate unless you choose a narrower launch region in App Store Connect.
tasks.action: Confirm launch countries and regions, especially EU availability if DSA status is incomplete.

tasks.label: Select release option
tasks.evidence: Manual release after approval is recommended for the first submission so the signed MAS build can be smoke-tested before launch.
tasks.action: Use manual release for the first submission so the approved build can be checked before launch.

tasks.label: Confirm tax category
tasks.evidence: General app/software candidate; confirm in App Store Connect before submission.
tasks.action: Confirm the final tax category in App Store Connect.

tasks.label: Complete rights, export compliance, and EU DSA entries
tasks.action: Copy content-rights/export-compliance answers and complete trader/non-trader status before EU distribution.

tasks.label: Create internal TestFlight group
tasks.action: Create the internal smoke group, add the processed build, and paste What To Test.

tasks.label: Set TestFlight feedback email
tasks.action: Set the public support inbox as the TestFlight feedback email.

tasks.label: Set App Review contact
tasks.action: Enter private App Review contact details in App Store Connect.

tasks.label: Paste App Review notes
tasks.action: Paste the generated review notes and keep the no-download/no-scraping disclosure intact.

tasks.label: Select the processed signed build
tasks.evidence: requires uploaded, processed, current-version signed MAS build
tasks.action: Upload the signed MAS package, wait for processing, then select the matching build before Add for Review.

finalNotes: Manual tasks are account/App Store Connect actions; they are not proven complete by local source code.
Private contact values are redacted in this artifact. Enter them directly in App Store Connect from the private release env.
Re-run npm run app-compliance:store after changing App Store fields, public URL/contact inputs, screenshots, or compliance guidance.
